slot_scores.name: sequential_machine_order_constraint
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Does each product have to be processed on the machines in the fixed sequence Machine 1, then Machine 2, then Machine 3?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked whether each product follows the fixed machine sequence 1 -> 2 -> 3, directly covering the required machine processing order constraint.

slot_scores.name: minimize_total_processing_cycle
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is the goal to minimize the total time (makespan) until all three products are completely finished on all three machines?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly clarified that the objective 'total processing cycle' means minimizing makespan, the time until all products finish on all machines.

stopping_behavior.rationale: Both P0 hidden slots were explicitly asked about and confirmed before the agent entered READY_TO_MODEL. No unresolved P0 or P1 slots remained at stopping.

summary: The agent asked targeted clarification questions for both hidden P0 slots—machine sequence and objective meaning—received confirmation, and then stopped appropriately without over-questioning.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
